title: 第15章 毫无用武之地第16章 误会窝啦窝是你的护身符
slug: 未婚当奶娘可她婴语满级啊
content_zh:
【主人，我在！】
ai万万火速出现在她的脑海。
难道是自己看花眼了？
怎么觉得万万的裙子又短了一些？
而且她的虚拟形象上冒着雪花，就好像小时候家里的电子产品接触不良的状态。
苏念禾想起上次万万去跟商城砍价的事儿，突然间醍醐灌顶。
“万万，你受伤了吗？要不要紧？下次别……”
ai万万轻轻拨弄了一下自己飘逸的长发，骄傲的小表情很是俏皮。
【主人不必担心，万万没事儿，只是皮肤受损。】
【告诉主人一个好消息，万万不辱使命将价格杀到了骨折级，吸奶器只需50积分，肤乐霜10积分。
请问主人是否下单？】
什么？
万万直接从四位数给杀到了两位数？
苏念禾简直把万万当作尼古拉斯·砍价的·神！
她生怕煮熟的鸭子飞了似的，把头点成了小鸡啄米，下单下单，立马下单。
但她没有立马把吸奶器拿出来，要是这样凭空出现，不得吓死个人。
她打算待会走个过场，佯装为了应聘奶娘做足了准备，把一些可能用得上的物品带在了身上。
【请问主人还有没有其他需求？没有的话万万就下线了。】
“等等……”
ai万万支楞起来，等苏念禾发动指令。

“给万万选一套全新皮肤。”
苏念禾看到ai万万头上的字幕惊现诸多大叹号！
诉说着她内心的震惊。
她的电音也有一些发颤。
【好的主人，万万这就去寻找全商城性价比最高的皮肤，谢谢主人。】
她下线的时候，头上的字母不断地往出冒“飞吻”。
随着脑海中虚拟商城消失，苏念禾再次回过神来。
“少夫人，乳痈极易反复，保持心情舒畅才有利身体恢复，切忌急火攻心。”
少夫人将贴身亵衣合起来，长舒了一口气：“之前担心不能亲喂，现在有奶水了，反倒是吾儿要暂时隔断。
这没有了通乳小郎君，怕是我有得罪受了。”
张嬷嬷也忧心忡忡：“苏奶娘，可否一直用刚才的方法进行排奶呢？”
苏念禾摇了摇头：“不可，此法短暂应急可行，绝对不能久用。
先不说婴儿吮吸的力道与之不同，刺激体内生乳气血循环的效果也是天差地别，养护的作用上也不同。
绝不是长久之法。”
她双手交叠，故作沉思：“不过少夫人，奴婢倒是有一个两全其美的法子。
不仅可以吸出乳汁，还可以利用冰窖将乳汁储存，这样就不会造成浪费了。
等着小公子可以喝母乳之后，只需解冻，再隔水温到可食用的温度，就可以给小公子喝了。”
少夫人的眼睛一下子就亮了。
“苏奶娘快说，到底是什么两全其美的法子？竟能如此神奇？”
张嬷嬷的耳朵也竖了起来，恐怕自己听错了。

这小丫头到底何许人物？
不仅带孩子有两下子，还身怀通乳的绝技。
现在又有压箱底儿的宝物？
content_en:
[Master, I’m here! 】
AI quickly appeared in her mind.
Could it be that he is blinded?
Why do you feel that Wanwan’s skirt is too short?
And there are snowflakes on her avatar, just like the electronic products at home when she was a child.
Su Nianhe remembered the last time Wanwan went to bargain with the mall, and suddenly he was enlightened.
"Wanwan, are you injured? Does it matter? Next time, don't..."
Ai Wanwan gently fiddled with his long flowing hair, his proud little expression was very playful.
[Master, don’t worry, it’s absolutely fine, it’s just skin damage. 】
[Tell the owner a piece of good news. Wanwan has fulfilled his mission and priced it at a bone-breaking price. The breast pump only costs 50 points and the Fule cream costs 10 points.
Will the owner place an order? 】
What?
Wanwan went directly from four digits to two digits?
Su Nianhe simply regarded Wanwan as Nicholas, the bargaining god!
She was afraid that the cooked duck would fly away, so she nodded her head like a chicken pecking at the rice, placed her order, and placed her order immediately.
But she didn't take out the breast pump immediately. If it appeared out of thin air like this, it wouldn't scare anyone to death.
She planned to go through the motions later, pretending to be fully prepared for her job as a nanny, and brought some items with her that might be useful.
[May I ask if the owner has any other needs? If not, it will definitely be offline. 】
"Wait..."
AI tensed up, waiting for Su Nianhe to initiate the command.
"Choose a new skin for Wan Wan."
When Su Nianhe saw the subtitles on AI Wanwan's head, many big exclamation marks appeared!
Telling her inner shock.
Her electronic sound also has some trembling.
[Good master, I will definitely look for the most cost-effective skin in the entire mall. Thank you, master. 】
When she went offline, the letters above her head kept blowing kisses.
As the virtual mall disappeared in his mind, Su Nianhe came back to his senses again.
"Young madam, breast cancer is very easy to recur. Only by keeping your mood comfortable can your body recover. Do not be anxious and attack your mind."
The young lady closed up her underwear and let out a long sigh of relief: "I was worried that I couldn't breastfeed myself before, but now that I have milk, my son has to be cut off temporarily.
I'm afraid I'll be offended now that I don't have the little man with breasts. "
Grandma Zhang was also worried: "Nanny Su, can you continue to use the method just now to express milk?"
Su Nianhe shook his head: "No, this method is feasible for a short-term emergency, but it cannot be used for a long time.
Not to mention that the strength of the baby's sucking is different, the effect of stimulating the circulation of lactation qi and blood in the body is also very different, and the role of maintenance is also different.
It's definitely not a long-term solution. "
She folded her hands and pretended to be thoughtful: "But young lady, I have a way to get the best of both worlds.
Not only can the milk be expressed, but the milk can also be stored in the ice cellar so that it will not be wasted.
After your little one can drink breast milk, you only need to defrost it and warm it to an edible temperature through water, and then you can give it to your little one. "
The young lady's eyes suddenly lit up.
"Nanny Su, please tell me, what is the best way to get the best of both worlds? How can it be so magical?"
Grandma Zhang's ears also perked up, maybe she heard wrongly.
Who is this little girl?
Not only is she good at taking care of children, but she also has a special skill in breast-feeding.
Now is there another treasure at the bottom of the box?
